parameters.query:
UPDATE sector_analyses
SET
  "soilAnalyses" = COALESCE(
    NULLIF($j${{ $('aggregateResultsByType').first().json.soilAnalyses }}$j$, '')::jsonb,
    "soilAnalyses"
  ),
  "soilAnalysisHistory" = COALESCE(
    NULLIF($j${{ $('aggregateResultsByType').first().json.soilAnalysisHistory }}$j$, '')::jsonb,
    "soilAnalysisHistory"
  ),
  "leafTissueAnalysis" = COALESCE(
    NULLIF($j${{ $('aggregateResultsByType').first().json.leafTissueAnalysis }}$j$, '')::jsonb,
    "leafTissueAnalysis"
  ),
  "status" = 'success'
WHERE sector_id = $${{ $('Set Sector ID').first().json.sectorId }}$$;
